messages.subject: Mandatory equipment inspection
messages.body:
Unit 04,

Please report to the armoury before the end of morning rotations. Any unregistered enchanted equipment must be declared.

Regards,
Owen Pike

Maya

messages.subject: Annual arcane exposure checks

Dr. Shah
